categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Junshi Biosciences Co., Ltd. is an innovation-driven biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, clinical research, and commercialization of innovative drugs globally. Its product portfolio covers five major therapeutic areas: malignant tumors, autoimmune diseases, chronic metabolic diseases, neurologic diseases, and infectious diseases. The company has commercialized four drugs including TUOYI® (toripalimab), JUNMAIKANG, MINDEWEI, and JUNSHIDA, with around 30 drug candidates in clinical trials and over 20 in preclinical development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced biotechnology R&D platforms and a comprehensive R&D system, including monoclonal antibodies, small molecule drugs, polypeptide drugs, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), bi-specific or multi-specific antibodies, bispecific ADCs, fusion proteins, and nucleic acid drugs. It emphasizes original innovation and codevelopment, with strong capabilities in translational medicine and next-generation therapies. Production is supported by two GMP-certified manufacturing bases with fermentation capacities of 4,500L and 42,000L, meeting PRC, US, and EU standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Junshi serves hospitals, specialty pharmacies, and community pharmacies primarily in China, with TUOYI® sold in about 6,000 medical institutions and over 3,000 pharmacies nationwide. Its products target patients with various cancers, autoimmune diseases, metabolic and infectious diseases. Internationally, the company markets toripalimab and other drugs in the US, EU, UK, India, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong SAR, Jordan, and other countries, collaborating with partners to cover over 80 countries across multiple continents.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in the People's Republic of China and the United States, with significant international presence in Europe (including all 27 EU member states, Iceland, Norway, Liechtenstein), the UK, India, Singapore, Australia, Jordan, and Hong Kong SAR. It has ongoing marketing applications or approvals in countries across Latin America, Middle East, North Africa, Southeast Asia, and others, reflecting a global commercial footprint spanning four continents.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Junshi Biosciences operates across the entire biopharmaceutical industry chain, encompassing upstream innovative drug discovery and development, midstream clinical research and trials, and downstream large-scale production and commercialization. It owns and manages manufacturing facilities certified by multiple regulatory authorities, enabling control over production quality and capacity to support global commercialization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven R&D with a focus on original innovation and codevelopment of first-in-class or best-in-class drugs. It accelerates late-stage clinical development and marketing applications for key products like toripalimab and tifcemalimab, while advancing early-stage pipelines including ADCs, bispecific antibodies, small molecule inhibitors, and fusion proteins. It integrates R&D resources via an Innovation Research Institute and emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent management to enhance R&D efficiency and quality.
categories.revenue_model: Junshi generates revenue primarily through pharmaceutical product sales, licensing income including upfront payments, milestone payments, and sales-based royalties, and technical service income related to R&D. The majority of revenue comes from sales of its core product TUOYI® and other commercialized drugs, supplemented by income from out-licensing agreements and research services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading innovative biopharmaceutical firm in China with strong global recognition, especially in immuno-oncology. It is among the few Chinese companies with FDA-approved innovative biologics and has a broad international marketing footprint. Its core product toripalimab is the first domestic anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody approved in China and the US, recommended by major oncology guidelines, and competes in markets with established global pharmaceutical companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, the Group reported total revenue of approximately RMB1,948 million, a 30% increase year-on-year, driven mainly by a 66% increase in domestic sales of TUOYI®. R&D expenses decreased by 34% to RMB1,275 million due to cost control and clinical trial progress. The loss attributable to owners narrowed by 44% to RMB1,282 million. The company maintains a strong cash position with RMB2,917 million in bank balances and financial products, supporting ongoing development and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Junshi emphasizes original innovation and high-quality, trustworthy innovative drugs that address unmet medical needs globally. Its core product, toripalimab, is distinguished as the first domestically developed anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody approved in multiple major markets and recommended by leading clinical guidelines. The company offers a diversified pipeline with multiple drug modalities and indications, supported by robust clinical evidence and international regulatory approvals, enhancing patient access and affordability through inclusion in national reimbursement drug lists.
